title: Single Modulus Prescaler
text: Integer clock divider that divides frequency of input signal, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Enable increased buffer size} and {Buffer size} sets the number of samples of the input buffering available during. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: div-by
ports.summary: Ratio of output to input clock frequency scalar integer

params.name: Enable increased buffer size
params.values: Enable increased buffer size off (default) | on

params.name: Buffer size
params.values: Number of samples of the input buffering available during simulation 1 (default) | positive integer scalar
